tests.device_gpu device_real_rollback: passed: new_run_rollback returns an error on ROCm (no qr_snapshots), so the test returns early, as written for bridges without snapshots

rocm_verify_fallback_bug.before_fix: error: verify_rollback: more rows than snapshots + 1 (exit 1, at every --tokens)
rocm_verify_fallback_bug.cause: run_verify probed rollback support with verify_rollback(&ids[..1]); one row needs no snapshot, so the probe succeeds on a plain new_run and the 2-row timing then fails
rocm_verify_fallback_bug.fix: rollback is available exactly when new_run_rollback succeeded; the probe and its reset() are gone (src/device/cli.rs)
